title: US Top Level Domain (usTLD) Registry Management Services
agency: COMMERCE, DEPARTMENT OF.OFFICE OF THE SECRETARY.DEPT OF COMMERCE SSPO
description_text: The Department seeks an Administrator for the .usTLD to provide both the baseline services described in accordance with the attached Requirements Document. Please read ALL documents fully. Pay specific attention on Section L.3. Phased Procurement Schedule and note that dates change, and if so, will be posted as an amendment. However, the Phase 1 Submission due date is 18 May 2026. The Q&A is posted in this final solicitation. There is NO additional Q&A period for this solicitation. When responding, add both contacts in your email (Jacqueline Brown and Blen Gabriel); Please use the notice ID #1331L526R13350002 .usTLD in your subject line.
